title: Q-learning Decision Transformer: Leveraging Dynamic Programming for Conditional Sequence Modelling in Offline RL

methods.one_paragraph_description: QDT first trains a conservative Q-learning (CQL) agent on the offline dataset to obtain a conservative value function, then relabels the return-to-go (RTG) of every trajectory in the dataset using the learned value estimates (Algorithm 1: initialise last-state RTG to zero, walk backwards, replace RTG where the value estimate is larger), and finally trains a standard Decision Transformer on the relabelled dataset. At runtime it acts exactly like DT: conditioned on a target RTG, it autoregressively predicts actions from the last K (RTG, state, action) tokens.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: conditional sequence modelling / reward-conditioned DT combined with dynamic programming (Q-learning); paper title: 'Leveraging Dynamic Programming for Conditional Sequence Modelling in Offline RL'
